reports.title: Amkor Technology Reports Financial Results for the Third Quarter 2026

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: The following information presents Amkor’s guidance for the fourth quarter 2026 (unless otherwise noted):
•Net income of $160 million to $185 million, or $0.65 to $0.75 per diluted share
•Full year 2026 capital expenditures updated to approximately $2.5 billion
